name: SyntaxUI
summary: Free React + Tailwind + Framer Motion UI components and animations (copy-paste).

install.command: Open https://syntaxui.com/components/{slug} and copy the React + Tailwind code

gaps: docsUrl points to /components/accordion because /components and /docs returned HTTP 500 at research time.
Some parent category routes (/components/button, /docs) return HTTP 500 at research time; leaf demo pages used for iframeSrc return 200.
Pilot includes 12 free showcase comps; SyntaxUI Pro blocks/templates excluded.
Copy-paste only (no npm package / shadcn registry).
